ctaHeading: Ready to refresh your Hillside home?
aboutText: Tohmes Painting and Cleaning Services has been delivering exceptional internal and external painting across Melbourne for over two decades. Based in Hillside, we bring unmatched craftsmanship and a commitment to excellence to homes and commercial spaces throughout Victoria. Our experienced team uses quality materials and proven techniques to ensure every project is completed to the highest standard. Whether you need a single room refreshed or a complete property makeover, Tohmes Painting delivers outstanding results every time.
servicesText: From internal residential painting to full external makeovers, we deliver flawless results for homes and businesses across Melbourne's western suburbs.

services.title: Internal Residential Painting
services.desc: Transform your living spaces with our meticulous internal painting services. We specialise in precision finishes for walls, ceilings, and trim throughout your home.

services.title: Internal Commercial Painting
services.desc: We provide efficient internal painting for offices, retail spaces, and commercial properties, minimising disruption while delivering professional, vibrant results.

services.title: External Residential Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior with our expert external painting. We use premium, weather-resistant coatings to keep your property looking brilliant.

services.title: External Commercial Painting
services.desc: From building facades to warehouses, our external commercial painting services ensure your business premises make a lasting, colourful impression.

services.title: Surface Preparation
services.desc: Proper preparation is the foundation of a perfect finish. We handle sanding, filling, priming, and cleaning to ensure paint adhesion and longevity.

services.title: Specialised Finishes
services.desc: Add character with feature walls, decorative painting, and textured finishes tailored to your personal style and property requirements.
